Title: General Tool Friction Notes
Content: Friction found while making MemorySmith use its own wiki: local runs need a Development launch profile for static web assets, MudBlazor providers must live in the interactive render tree, source wiki data must be copied before tests mutate it, and the on-disk JSON shape should be made friendlier over time. More general use will need better import/export, semantic indexing, MCP tools, and schema/version migration support.
